Enforcement of Act VIII of 1851 and XV of 1864 in the Punjab

THE TOLLS ACT, 1888
THE TOLLS ACT, 1888
ACT No. VIII of 1888
[Short title given by the Short Titles Act, 1897 (14 of
1897).
For Statement of Objects and
Reasons, see Gazette of India, 1888, Pt. V, p. 43, and for Proceedings in
Council, see ibid., Pt. VI, pp. 82 and 93.
This Act
has been extended and shall be deemed to have been so ex tended to the whole of
Pakistan by the Central Laws (Statute Reform) Ordinance 1960 (21 of 1960), s. 3
and 2nd Sch. (with effect from the 14th October ,1955).]
[The word "Indian"
rep. by the Federal Laws (Revision and Declara tion) Act, 1951 (26 of 1951), s.
3 and II Sch.]
[5th September, 1888]
1. Enforcement of Act VIII of
1851 and XV of 1864 in the Punjab. Acts VIII of 1851 and XV of 1864 shall
be deemed to be in force throughout the territories now administered by the
Lieutenant‑Governor of the Punjab, and from the twenty‑first day of
August, 1857, and the twenty‑fourth day of March, 1864, respectively, to
have been in force in the territories for the time being administered as part
of the Punjab.

2.‑ Operation of the Act
in the Punjab and certain other Parts of Pakistan (1) In any part of [Subs. by Ord., 21 of 1960, s. 3 and 2nd Sch. (with effect
from the 14th October, 1955), for "the Provinces and the Capital of the
Federation" which had been subs. by A. O., 1949, Arts. 3(2) and 4, for
"British India".] Pakistan beyond the limits of [Subs. by Act 26 of 1951, s. 4 and III Sch., for "the
territories administered by the Governor of Fort St. George in Council, and the
Lieutenant -Governors of Bengal and the North-Western Provinces".] such
of the territories administered on the 4th of July, 1851, by the Lieutenant‑Governor
of Bengal as on the fifteenth of August, 1947, formed part of East Bengal, to
or in which Acts VIII of 1851 and XV of 1864 may be or have been extended, or
may be or have been declared to be in force, under the latter of those Acts or
by this Act or by or under any other enactment, the [Subs.
by A. O., 1937, for "L. G. ".] Provincial Government shall be
deemed to have and, where the Acts have been in force before the passing of
this Act, to have had the same authority as if it had been included among the [Subs. Ibid., for "Local Governments".]
Provincial Governments specified in section 2 of Act VIII of 1851.
[Sub‑section
(2) rep., ibid.]

3. Validation of Past levy of
tolls. All tolls levied, or purporting to have been levied, under Acts VIII
of 1851 and XV of 1864, or either of those Acts, before the passing of this
Act, shall be deemed to have been lawfully levied.
